description: Spec §7.5, on a BRUTE: ShieldBubble is hidden on a fresh car, shown right after ActivateShield (its centre within 2 cm of Body x (2.2, 0, 95.8)), and hidden ShieldDuration + 0.2 s later (the test ticks after the car). Shielded again, a blocked hit sets the bubble MID's Glow to 3, and 0.5 s later it is back to the MI's glow.
